result.analyst_notes: Headline-driven page: each value is a short heading followed by a third-person associate anecdote, so commitments are aspirational and mostly unhedged. Voice shifts between first-person plural 'we' and descriptive narrative. Shareholder return is stated plainly with a firm 'We are committed' line. Customers, employees and community lead; environment and safety are absent.
